summary: Extended the Agent layer to all 12 Chief personas, completing the pattern started under trail dc6a78dc for the 5 lifecycle roles. All 17 registered lifecycle+persona roles now have a Claude Code native subagent definition at .agents/agents/ composing their existing skill and governance contract by reference, each with a permission-derived tools allowlist and an Economic Rationale grounded in the real mechanism the role implements rather than an invented figure.
earned_constraints: when a group of roles shares one governance contract shape (here: all 12 Chiefs share the same may/mayNot permissions, differing only by domain), a single generator script with per-role data substitution is both faster and less error-prone than 12 hand-written files, and makes the shared invariant (e.g. no Edit/Write across all 12) trivially auditable in one place rather than re-verified 12 times

a domain-specific Economic Rationale is not always achievable or honest - when 12 roles genuinely share one mechanism, the rationale should say so once and let the verbatim domain description carry the differentiation, rather than manufacturing 12 distinct cost narratives that would not be independently checkable
next_seed: None required. The Agent layer (.agents/agents/) is now complete for all 17 agents.yaml lifecycle+persona entries. A natural further increment, if wanted, would be extending it to reasoning-catalog or the marketplace scaffolders, but neither was requested and both are 'tool'/'marketplace-scaffold' kind rather than lifecycle/persona, so the same delegation framing may not fit without rethinking it first.
